title.en: Accelerator demand meets a tougher efficiency benchmark

title.en: Do not treat diversified power revenue as pure SiC demand
title.zh: 勿將多元功率營收當成純 SiC 需求

summary.en: Bearish on using diversified company results as a pure SiC growth proxy. Operating recovery is real evidence, but material-specific demand needs separate disclosure.
summary.zh: 不看好將多元公司業績當作純 SiC 成長代理指標。營運復甦具證據，但材料別需求需要獨立揭露。

title.en: Do not treat diversified power revenue as pure SiC demand

body.en: Bearish on using diversified company results as a pure SiC growth proxy. Operating recovery is real evidence, but material-specific demand needs separate disclosure.

text.en: Analyst interpretation: the company release covers multiple power technologies. A stronger company margin would weaken our cautious proxy thesis, but would still not isolate SiC revenue.
text.zh: 分析判斷：公司公告涵蓋多種功率技術。全公司毛利率走強會削弱我們對代理指標的審慎論點，但仍無法拆出 SiC 營收。

text.en: The reported GAAP gross margin of 38.4% is company-wide, not a disclosed SiC margin; it does not establish a material-specific advantage.
text.zh: 揭露的 GAAP 毛利率 38.4% 屬全公司而非 SiC 毛利率，不能證明特定材料優勢。

text.en: onsemi reported $1.604B revenue, evidence of operating scale that argues against dismissing the supplier's recovery.
text.zh: onsemi 揭露營收 $1.604B，營運規模是不能忽視供應商復甦的反向證據。
